henry.title: Twinkle, Twinkle: Mozart's Star Tune + the F Chord
henry.intro: One star song, played 12 ways by Mozart. You'll play it on piano and learn chord 3. (Redo of last week's unfinished lesson. About 15 minutes.)
steps: 🎵 Listen to the first minute of Mozart's variations.
🎹 Play Twinkle on piano: C C G G A A G.
🎸 Learn F: two fingers, like the picture.
🔁 Strum C, F, C while you sing line 1.
✏️ Fill in the worksheet.
links: Listen to the first minute. Hear the plain tune, then the fast notes.

passage.text: ⭐ The words of Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star are from a poem by Jane Taylor, from 1806. The tune is even older. It's a French song.
passage.q: What country is the tune from?

passage.text: 🎹 The composer Mozart wrote 12 variations on the tune. A variation is the same tune, changed. It can be faster, fancier or sadder.
🔤 The ABC song uses the same tune! So does Baa, Baa, Black Sheep.
passage.q: Name a song with the same tune.
passage.a: The ABC song (or Baa, Baa, Black Sheep).

passage.text: 🎸 Line 1 uses 2 chords. C on 'Twinkle, twinkle', F on 'little', C on 'star'.

handsOn.title: 🎹 Twinkle on piano + 🎸 F chord
steps: guides/piano-c-to-a.svg
Find C: the white key just left of the 2 black keys.
guides/piano-c-to-a.svg
Play C C G G A A G. Then F F E E D D C. That's line 1!
guides/piano-c-to-a.svg
Make a variation: play each note twice as fast, or very soft.
guides/uke-f-chord.svg
Uke: pointer on the E string, fret 1. Middle on the G string, fret 2.
guides/uke-c-chord.svg
Switch: C 4 strums, F 4 strums. Count switches with no stop.
guides/uke-f-chord.svg
Sing: 'Twinkle, twinkle' (C), 'little' (F), 'star' (C).
handsOn.look: F needs 2 fingers, so press with fingertips and keep your thumb behind the neck. The rest of the song needs a G7 chord, coming soon.
handsOn.q: Questions 5 to 7 come from the piano and uke.

worksheet: The Twinkle tune is a ______ song. Circle: French / Japanese
A variation is: Circle: the same tune, changed / a brand new song
Same tune: Circle: ABC song / Happy Birthday
Piano: C C G G A A ___. Circle: G / F
For F: pointer on the ____ string, middle on the ____ string. Circle: E / A · G / C
I switched C → F ____ times. Challenge: My variation was: faster / softer / higher
henry.challenge: Make your own variation of line 1 on the piano: change the speed, the loudness or play it higher. Play it for someone and ask them to guess the song.

frankie.title: Twinkle, Twinkle + Star Stickers ⭐🎹
frankie.intro: Grown-up, read aloud: At night we see stars. Some stars make shapes. Today we play a star song and make the Big Dipper with stickers! (Redo of last week's unfinished lesson. About 14 minutes.)
steps: 🏷️ Add a new purple 6 sticker after the red 5.
🎶 Play Twinkle, Twinkle with the dots.
⭐ Stick 7 star stickers like the Big Dipper.
🔤 Sound out d-o-t. Trace, then write it (stretch!).

handsOn.title: 🎹 Twinkle + ⭐ Big Dipper
steps: guides/piano-c-to-a.svg
🏷️ Grown-up: put a purple 6 sticker on the white key right after red 5.
guides/twinkle-numbers.svg
🎶 Press: 1 1 5 5 6 6 5 · 4 4 3 3 2 2 1. Sing along!
guides/big-dipper.svg
⭐ Put 7 star stickers on dark paper, like the picture. (Or use 7 coins or LEGO.)
guides/big-dipper.svg
🔢 Count them: 3 in the handle, 4 in the cup.
handsOn.look: Grown-up: the jump from 1 up to 5 is the hard part. Point to the red 5 first.
